title: Cage Lock Code (Basement Prison) - Puzzle Solution
description: Read the three clues around your cage: the paper figure has eight arms (Triangle = 8), your cage is number five (Square = 5), and the paper in cage six shows a circle over the number 2 (O = 2). Enter O=2, Square=5, Triangle=8.

title: Electrical Room Door Key (Basement) - Puzzle Solution
description: The Electrical door is locked until you grab the Key from the workbench down the long corridor. A Mutant appears as soon as you take it — hide in the nearby locker, hold your breath when prompted, then unlock the door.

title: Sewer 4-Digit Door Code - Puzzle Solution
description: The full code is 5861. The first half (58**) is written behind a shelf in the maintenance area; the second half (**61) is on the wall near the second red cyst.

title: Half-Pipe Alignment (Sewer Lower Service Channel) - Puzzle Solution
description: Connect every half-pipe so the exploding balls roll unimpeded to the fingers in the water area. Pull both railing switches first, then press the four buttons in this order: 1st, 4th, 1st, 3rd.

title: Valve Drainage (Sewer Hideout) - Puzzle Solution
description: Rotate each valve set so the metal pipes face the directions shown: Set 1 (2 valves): left ×2 down, right ×1 left. Set 2 (3 valves): left ×1 up, middle untouched, right ×1 left. Set 3 (4 valves): ×1 up, ×2 down, ×1 down, ×2 left. Set 4 (2 valves, tunnel): left ×1 down, right ×1 left. A sound confirms each correct set.

title: Machine Room Door Code (Sewer Hideout) - Puzzle Solution
description: The full door code is 3752. A concrete fragment beside the door shows one hinted digit with three blank spaces; the complete code opens the machine room, where the Toy Carousel waits inside a wall reach.

title: Venus Hand Traps - Puzzle Solution
description: Venus Hand Traps are the hands along floors and water that grab and hold you. Tap the prompted button to break free, toss a stone to make them retreat, or shoot one (before it grabs you) for the Handshot achievement.

title: Red Blister Finger Gates (The Organism) - Puzzle Solution
description: Finger clusters block the way. Shoot the glowing red blister on the nearby wall to make the fingers retract and open the path.

title: Trespassing Achievement
description: How to unlock: Story — enter the hospital building in Chapter 1 (The Hospital). Unmissable. (79.8% of players)

title: Escape Artist Achievement
description: How to unlock: Story — escape the basement prison area at the end of the Basement chapter. Unmissable. (52.3% of players)

title: Happy Reunion Achievement
description: How to unlock: Story — retrieve your pistol during the Basement chapter. Unmissable. (48.7% of players)

title: Science and History Achievement
description: How to unlock: Story — complete the Sewer chapter (rescue Sam from the burning police car). Unmissable. (31.2% of players)

title: Armed and Ready Achievement
description: How to unlock: Pick up the shotgun on the table in the Sewer maintenance area (the room with the Proof of Purchase note). (28.4% of players)

title: Sharp Senses Achievement
description: How to unlock: Let a Minion grab you (first ones appear in the Basement), then press the prompted button to kill it with your knife. Saves ammo. (34.1% of players)

title: First Upgrade Achievement
description: How to unlock: Spend an Upgrade Bolt at any workbench. Bolts are found on crates and dropped by glowing cysts. (26.7% of players)

title: Handshot Achievement
description: How to unlock: Shoot a Venus Hand Trap (the hands along the floor that grab and hold you). First ones appear in the Sewer Hideout drainage pool area. (41.2% of players)

title: Fully Upgraded Achievement
description: How to unlock: Fully upgrade one weapon at workbenches using Upgrade Bolts. Tip: only spend bolts on the handgun. Note: an early patch fixed this not triggering — if that happened to you, revisit a workbench and activate every upgrade (scroll the list). (3.7% of players)

title: Touchy Subject Achievement
description: How to unlock: Walk up to a big hand in the Sewer and let it kill you. It is happy to oblige. You restart at the area's checkpoint. (18.9% of players)

title: What's in the Hole? Achievement
description: How to unlock: Reach inside a fleshy hole in a wall. The first one is in the Sewer's 5861 code-door room (it holds the son's family drawing), so this comes naturally while collecting. (44.5% of players)

title: "Bring your child to work" - Day Achievement
description: How to unlock: Reach inside the fleshy wall in the dark corridor right of the desk with the Guilt note (Sewer Hideout, after the disappearing-bridge section). (22.7% of players)

title: Fetch! Achievement
description: How to unlock: In the Sewer Hideout flooded lower area, lure the hands in the water away with stones, cross to the far side, and reach inside the wall. (19.4% of players)

title: Round and round we go. Achievement
description: How to unlock: Found in the Sewer Hideout playground/sandbox area while working through the platform-switch sequence. (17.6% of players)

title: In good hands. Achievement
description: How to unlock: Inside the Sewer's 5861 code-door room: interact with the fleshy wall to reach inside and pull it out. (21.3% of players)

title: A great team! Achievement
description: How to unlock: In the Sewer half-pipe area, drop into the water, open the back-wall door, pull the switch to open the pipe cover, then reach inside the wall. (18.7% of players)

title: What is he made of?! Achievement
description: How to unlock: Once you have the handgun in the Basement's experiment area, shoot William Blake. It does nothing — but you get the achievement. (15.2% of players)

title: Forgiveness Achievement
description: How to unlock: Finish the final chapter (The Organism). Unmissable if you complete the story. (24.8% of players)

title: Rest in Pieces Achievement
description: How to unlock: In The Organism's explosives area, damage the Cage Monster with gunfire but make the FINAL hit a red explosive barrel. Shooting a barrel stuns it — with a strong shotgun you can burst it down between stuns. (8.3% of players)

title: Early Grave Achievement
description: How to unlock: In the Sewer Hideout steam pipe area, when the Cage Monster busts through the door, kill it with gunfire. This fight happens before the chapter's end. (5.8% of players)

title: Toy Police Car - Collectible Location
description: Where to find the Toy Police Car: The Sewer Hideout. After crossing the vanishing bridge, enter the next room and check the desk with the Guilt note. Step into the dark corridor beside it and reach inside the fleshy wall on the right.

title: Photograph of the Family Dog - Collectible Location
description: Where to find the Photograph of the Family Dog: The Sewer Hideout. In the waist-deep water area, toss stones to lure the hands away from each crate before jumping. Reach the far side below the catwalk, enter the small room (two stones sit left of its door), and reach inside the wall.

title: Toy Carousel - Collectible Location
description: Where to find the Toy Carousel: The Sewer Hideout. In the loud machine room, take the right catwalk to the coded door. The hint on the concrete fragment gives you 3752. Open the door and reach inside the hole in the wall.

title: Son's Family Drawing - Collectible Location
description: Where to find the Son's Family Drawing: The Sewer. Find both code halves (58** behind the shelf, **61 by the second cyst), enter 5861 on the keycode door, then interact with the fleshy wall inside and reach in.

title: Worn Football - Collectible Location
description: Where to find the Worn Football: The Sewer. Drop into the water in the half-pipe area, open the door along the back wall, grab the Upgrade Bolt, pull the switch to open the pipe cover, then reach inside the wall.
